gui.simplyspeakers.controller.title: Speaker Controller
gui.simplyspeakers.controller.proxy_help: Targets only this proxy. Its chunk must be loaded.

Choose an uploaded clip with a known duration
gui.simplyspeakers.controller.status.una: Action unavailable; check target and track
gui.simplyspeakers.controller.invalid_co: Enter three whole block coordinates: X Y Z.
gui.simplyspeakers.player.playlist_empty: Add tracks using the Library track menus.
gui.simplyspeakers.player.clear_playlist: Clear the saved track list? Audio files remain in the Library.
gui.simplyspeakers.player.queue_empty: No temporary requests. Playback follows the playlist.
gui.simplyspeakers.player.seek_help: Arrow keys adjust the position. Unavailable for unknown-duration streams.
gui.simplyspeakers.player.invalid_playli: Use a unique name of 1–64 characters.

gui.simplyspeakers.player.operation_fail: Playlist unavailable, duplicate name or library limit reached.

gui.simplyspeakers.access.title: Access

gui.simplyspeakers.access.player_help: Use an online player name or an offline player UUID.
gui.simplyspeakers.access.transfer_help: Use an online player name or UUID. Transferring ownership may remove your management access.
gui.simplyspeakers.access.invalid_player: Player not found. Use an online name or a complete UUID.
gui.simplyspeakers.access.trust_limit: The trusted list is full (128 players).
gui.simplyspeakers.access.no_control: You do not have control access to this speaker.

gui.simplyspeakers.stream.rejected: Audio unavailable, not owned by you, or blocked by server stream policy.
